01

Tenancy & Rent Services

Advisory on rent assessment, tenancy drafting, lease renewal, and lawful recovery of unpaid rent — grounded in Act 220 and L.I. 369.

  • A written, evidence-based advisory on the rent your premises can lawfully and defensibly command — prepared before you serve any increase or commencement notice. Includes comparable market analysis and a concluded rent range referenced to Act 220 and L.I. 369. Delivered as a formal PDF advisory report.

    Turnaround

    2–3 working days

    Fee

    GHS 200 – 400

  • A bespoke tenancy agreement drafted for your specific premises, parties, and agreed terms — grounded in Act 220 and current Ghanaian practice. Covers fixed-term, month-to-month, room rental, commercial, and kiosk/container tenancies. One round of revisions included. Delivered in Word and PDF.

    Turnaround

    1–2 working days

    Fee

    GHS 150 per agreement

  • Structured advisory on lawful rent collection procedures, arrears management, and the formal recovery process under Act 220 — including the correct sequence of warning notices, formal demand letters, and Rent Control referral. Includes a personalised arrears recovery action plan.

    Turnaround

    3–5 working days

    Fee

    GHS 500 – 1,000 (depending on property size)

  • Advisory and documentation support for tenancy renewals — including review of existing terms, preparation of a renewal offer letter, negotiation guidance, and drafting of the renewal agreement. Ensures compliance with L.I. 369 notice requirements for any rent revision.

    Turnaround

    2–3 working days

    Fee

    GHS 200 – 350

  • Step-by-step written guidance on the lawful process for recovering possession of your property — covering required notices, mandatory timelines, Form 9 preparation, Rent Control Department filing, and Magistrate Court procedure. Includes draft notices where applicable.

    Turnaround

    2–3 working days

    Fee

    GHS 200

02

Property Operations & Maintenance

Structured support for inspections, maintenance coordination, utility management, and renovation supervision across your portfolio.

  • On-site or document-based inspection with a written advisory report covering structural condition, electrical and plumbing assessment, pest findings, and recommendations — suitable for move-in, routine, move-out, and pre-letting inspections. Report can serve as evidence in Rent Control or court proceedings.

    Turnaround

    2–4 working days

    Fee

    GHS 100 – 300

  • Structured support in identifying, scoping, and coordinating maintenance works across one or more properties — including vendor sourcing, cost benchmarking, work order preparation, and completion verification. Particularly useful for absent landlords and portfolio managers.

    Turnaround

    By appointment

    Fee

    GHS 250 per hour

  • A property-specific preventive maintenance schedule covering electrical, plumbing, structural, roofing, and compound systems — with recommended inspection intervals, estimated costs, and a prioritised action list. Delivered as a written maintenance plan document.

    Turnaround

    3–5 working days

    Fee

    GHS 300 – 700

  • Advisory and supervisory support for renovation and refurbishment projects — including scope of works review, contractor assessment, progress monitoring visits, and a final completion sign-off report. Fee based on project scale and number of site visits required.

    Turnaround

    Project-based

    Fee

    GHS 500 – 1,500

  • Advisory on shared utility billing, ECG/NEDCo account management, service charge structures, and utility dispute resolution between landlords and tenants. Includes a written utility management framework for shared-occupancy properties.

    Turnaround

    2–3 working days

    Fee

    GHS 200 – 400

03

Advisory & Compliance

Compliance audits, Rent Control advisory, health and safety assessments, and investment due diligence for landlords and investors.

  • A property-by-property review of documentation, advance rent handling, receipt practices, and notice procedures — assessed against Act 220 and L.I. 369. Delivers a written audit report and a prioritised remediation checklist identifying all areas of non-compliance.

    Turnaround

    3–5 working days

    Fee

    GHS 500 – 1,000

  • Structured advisory on Rent Control Department procedures — including complaint filing, hearing preparation, Form 9 guidance, and understanding of Rent Officer and Rent Magistrate roles. Suitable for landlords preparing to file or respond to a complaint.

    Turnaround

    Same day / within 24 hours

    Fee

    GHS 250 per session

  • A written assessment of the health and safety condition of a residential or commercial property — covering structural hazards, electrical risk, water supply quality, sanitation, ventilation, and pest risk. Recommendations provided with priority classifications.

    Turnaround

    2–4 working days

    Fee

    GHS 350 – 700

  • A comprehensive due diligence review for prospective property purchasers, investors, or tenants — covering title verification, physical condition assessment, rental yield analysis, compliance status, and a concluded risk summary. Delivered as a formal Due Diligence Report.

    Turnaround

    3–5 working days

    Fee

    GHS 500 – 1,200

  • Evidence-based advisory on residential and commercial property investment decisions in Ghana — including rental yield projections, market comparisons, location analysis, and risk assessment. Delivered as a written investment advisory note for a specific property or portfolio decision.

    Turnaround

    3–5 working days

    Fee

    GHS 500 – 1,000

04

Dispute & Representation

Preparation and review of documentation for Rent Control or Magistrate Court proceedings — helping you build a complete, well-organised file before any hearing.

  • Preparation and review of documentation for Rent Control or Magistrate Court proceedings — including Form 9, written statements of facts, rent ledgers, and supporting evidence packages. Does not constitute legal representation; engagement of a lawyer is recommended for court appearances.

    Turnaround

    2–4 working days

    Fee

    GHS 400 – 800

05

Training & Digital Solutions

Landlord and tenant education, property record digitisation, management system setup, and standard operating procedure development.

  • Structured training for individual landlords or small landlord groups covering: Ghanaian tenancy law fundamentals, correct documentation practices, advance rent and deposit handling, notice procedures, and Rent Control processes. Delivered in person or remotely. Certificate of attendance available.

    Turnaround

    By appointment

    Fee

    GHS 300 – 600 per session

  • A structured orientation session for new or prospective tenants covering their rights and obligations under Act 220 — including rent receipts, notice requirements, deposit protection, maintenance reporting, and Rent Control access. Delivered individually or in small groups.

    Turnaround

    By appointment

    Fee

    GHS 150 – 300 per session

  • Review and organisation of existing property records, or setup of a structured digital record system covering tenancy agreements, rent receipts, inspection records, and correspondence — in formats compatible with Google Drive, OneDrive, or local storage. Includes a brief record-keeping guide.

    Turnaround

    2–5 working days

    Fee

    GHS 300 – 700

  • Advisory and hands-on setup of a property management system for landlords and agents — including configuration of tracking tools, rent collection workflows, maintenance logs, and reporting templates. Scope and fee confirmed at initial consultation based on portfolio size and system choice.

    Turnaround

    3–7 working days

    Fee

    GHS 500 – 1,499

  • Development of Standard Operating Procedures for property management operations — covering tenant onboarding, rent collection, maintenance management, inspection protocols, and staff responsibilities. Delivered as editable Word documents with version control. Suitable for agencies and multi-property landlords.

    Turnaround

    3–5 working days

    Fee

    GHS 400 – 1,000

The process

From enquiry to delivery — a simple, structured process.

01

Submit your request

Complete the service request form below. Tell us about your property, the service you need, and your timeline.

02

We confirm and scope

We review your request, confirm the service scope, and send you a written fee proposal within one working day.

03

We do the work

Your advisory, document, or consultation is prepared to the stated timelines — grounded in Act 220, L.I. 369, and Ghanaian practice.

04

Delivered in writing

Every service is delivered as a written document, report, or structured session — not a verbal opinion. You keep a record.

Why PRC

Grounded in law. Delivered in writing.

Every service delivered in writing

No verbal opinions. Every advisory, audit, and guidance note is a formal written document you can file, reference, or present at the Rent Control Department.

Built for Ghana's rental market

Our services are grounded in the Rent Act, 1963 (Act 220) and Rent Regulations, 1964 (L.I. 369) — not generic property management templates from other jurisdictions.

Clear timelines, no surprises

Every service carries a stated turnaround. You know what you are getting, when you will receive it, and what it will cost before we begin.
